{"notes": "VISIT 5 (left 10:00). Table: fish intact, nose to both tail tips (top curl ~(27.5,4.5), bottom ~(28,15.5)), all dark/connected. Doubled/tight dominoes at x=16.5-18 and x=20-21 still there, possible weak joins. Pale stray near (15,6) is still unconnected and unclaimed. No hands on the table. The countdown and 'hands off' calls were made, but I did not see the push or the fall, so the outcome is unknown. I still can't say who placed which domino, so build credit stays shared.

Maya: Called 'thirty seconds, fish is ready, hands off' at 9:30. Consistent leadership throughout: two-minute call, then a clean finish. She is the one who set the pace and prevented late tinkering. Still based on what I heard, not on seeing her build. Ask what she placed, how she ran handoffs, and whether she knew about the stray.

Tom: Echoed 'hands off' at 9:45. Supportive, nothing new. Earlier accurate status report shows attention. Ask what he built and whether the stray is his.

Priya: Said 'fingers crossed' at 9:45. Positive tone, no new substance. Earlier backed the hands-off plan. Can't confirm she placed the clean top arm. Ask her.

Leo: Confirmed 'all set here too' at 9:45, so he spoke up this time but still gave no detail. Visit 1 offer to take far ends may explain the tail, unseen, so no credit yet. Ask what he placed, who joined sections, and about the stray.

Provisional: strong team result, all four collaborative, Maya slightly ahead on leadership from the calls. No one lags on my evidence. Keep scores near the middle, with leadership a bit higher for Maya, until review conversations. Check the fall result, especially at the doubled joins."}
